mentions.name: BrandImageGen
mentions.description: An image generation tool that lets users try ideas across multiple AI models and modalities, supporting creativity as an iterative process of trial and error.
mentions.problem: Single-model image generation limits creative exploration; the tool addresses this by enabling trial and error across multiple models and modalities for expansive creativity.
mentions.source_excerpt: Created a new image generation tool because I believe creativity is a process of trial and error! So multiple models, infinite modality == expansive creativity. :)

evidence.value: Created a new image generation tool because I believe creativity is a process of trial and error! So multiple models, infinite modality == expansive creativity. :)
